scope: Cardholder data environment (CDE) — any system that stores, processes, or transmits cardholder data

requirements.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
requirements.summary: Network security controls (firewalls, routers, etc.) protect the CDE.

controls.title: Configuration standards for NSCs
controls.description: Defined and reviewed at least once every 12 months.

controls.title: All allowed services, protocols, and ports identified
controls.description: Documented and approved with business justification.

controls.title: Inbound traffic to CDE restricted
controls.description: Only traffic with explicit business justification permitted.

controls.title: Outbound traffic from CDE restricted
controls.description: Only traffic with explicit business justification permitted.

controls.title: NSCs implemented between trusted and untrusted networks
controls.description: Including between the CDE and any other network.

requirements.title: Apply Secure Configurations
requirements.summary: All system components must have secure configurations and not use vendor-default credentials.

controls.title: Configuration standards developed and maintained
controls.description: Address all known security vulnerabilities, consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.

controls.title: Vendor default accounts and removed/disabled
controls.description: Accounts and passwords managed before installation on the network.

controls.title: Wireless vendor defaults changed
controls.description: Including encryption keys, passwords, and SNMP community strings.

requirements.title: Protect Stored Account Data
requirements.summary: Account data (PAN, expiration, name, CVV) must be protected per requirements 3.1–3.7.

controls.title: Account data storage minimized
controls.description: Retained only as long as necessary, with documented data retention and disposal.

controls.title: Sensitive authentication data not stored after authorization
controls.description: Even if encrypted. Includes full track data, CAV2/CVC2/CVV2/CID, PINs/PIN blocks.

controls.title: PAN masked when displayed
controls.description: Maximum first six and last four digits displayable.

controls.title: PAN rendered unreadable wherever stored
controls.description: Via approaches: one-way hashing, truncation, tokenization, strong cryptography with key management.

controls.title: Cryptographic keys protected
controls.description: Documented procedures for cryptographic key management.

controls.title: Key management procedures defined
controls.description: Including generation, distribution, storage, rotation, retirement.

requirements.title: Protect Cardholder Data with Strong Cryptography During Transmission
requirements.summary: Cardholder data transmitted over open, public networks must use strong cryptography.

controls.title: Strong cryptography and security protocols implemented
controls.description: TLS 1.2 or higher. SSL and early TLS prohibited.

controls.title: Inventory of trusted keys and certificates
controls.description: Maintained and reviewed annually.

requirements.title: Protect All Systems and Networks from Malicious Software
requirements.summary: Anti-malware solutions deployed on all in-scope systems.

controls.title: Anti-malware deployed on all relevant systems
controls.description: Either on-host or via continuous behavioral analysis on all systems.

controls.title: Periodic scans, active scanning, real-time scanning
controls.description: Or continuous behavioral analysis active.

controls.title: Anti-malware cannot be disabled by users
controls.description: Or altered without administrative authorization.

requirements.title: Develop and Maintain Secure Systems and Software
requirements.summary: Security controls must be embedded in software development.

controls.title: Bespoke software developed securely
controls.description: With documented secure development standards.

controls.title: Software engineers trained at least annually
controls.description: On software security relevant to their role.

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities identified and addressed
controls.description: Including via vulnerability scanning, threat intel, etc.

controls.title: All system components protected from known vulnerabilities
controls.description: Vendor patches installed within one month of release for critical/high.

controls.title: Public-facing web applications protected
controls.description: Either: reviewed annually + after changes, OR automated technical solution detecting attacks.

controls.title: Payment page scripts managed
controls.description: Authorized scripts only on payment page; integrity controls implemented.

requirements.title: Restrict Access by Need-to-Know
requirements.summary: Access to system components and data must be appropriately restricted.

controls.title: Access control policy defines least-privilege model
controls.description: Based on job responsibilities and need-to-know.

controls.title: Access assigned to users based on classification and function
controls.description: Roles assigned with documented approval.

controls.title: User access reviews performed at least every 6 months
controls.description: All accounts reviewed including service accounts.

requirements.title: Identify Users and Authenticate Access
requirements.summary: All access to system components must be properly authenticated.

controls.title: Unique IDs assigned to each user
controls.description: Before access to system components or cardholder data is granted.

controls.title: Access authenticated via at least one factor
controls.description: Something you know, have, or are.

controls.title: Password requirements: minimum length 12+, complexity
controls.description: Includes both numeric and alphabetic.

controls.title: MFA implemented for all access into the CDE
controls.description: From any source: console, network, remote.

controls.title: MFA for all remote access
controls.description: Originating from outside the entity's network.

controls.title: MFA implementations not bypassable
controls.description: Except documented exceptions for service accounts.

requirements.title: Restrict Physical Access to Cardholder Data
requirements.summary: Physical access to systems and media containing cardholder data must be restricted.

controls.title: Physical security controls in place to limit access
controls.description: Both for facilities and individual rooms with sensitive areas.

controls.title: Media classified according to data sensitivity
controls.description: Inventory maintained.

controls.title: Inventory logs of all electronic media
controls.description: Reconciled at least annually.

requirements.title: Log and Monitor All Access
requirements.summary: Audit logs are critical for detecting and responding to security incidents.

controls.title: Audit logs enabled and active for all system components
controls.description: Track and link all access to system components by individual user.

controls.title: Logs record specific events
controls.description: User identification, event type, date/time, success/failure indication, origin, identity/name of affected data/component.

controls.title: Audit logs reviewed at least daily
controls.description: All security events, logs of system components storing/processing cardholder data, logs of critical security functions.

controls.title: Audit log history retained at least 12 months
controls.description: Last 3 months immediately available for analysis.

requirements.title: Test Security of Systems and Networks
requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities must be regularly identified through testing.

controls.title: Internal vulnerability scans quarterly
controls.description: Plus after any significant change.

controls.title: External vulnerability scans quarterly
controls.description: Performed by ASV (Approved Scanning Vendor).

controls.title: Penetration testing performed at least annually
controls.description: Plus after any significant change.

controls.title: External pentest performed annually
controls.description: From outside the network attacking inward.

controls.title: Internal pentest performed annually
controls.description: Validates segmentation effectiveness if used to reduce CDE scope.

controls.title: Intrusion detection and/or prevention deployed
controls.description: All traffic at the perimeter and at critical points within the CDE.

requirements.title: Support Information Security with Organizational Policies and Programs
requirements.summary: Maintain a comprehensive information security program.

controls.title: Overall security policy established and disseminated
controls.description: Reviewed at least annually and updated as needed.

controls.title: Risk assessment process formally defined
controls.description: Performed at least annually and upon significant changes.

controls.title: Cryptographic cipher suites and protocols inventoried
controls.description: Reviewed annually.

controls.title: Inventory of system components in scope for PCI DSS
controls.description: Including their function and PCI DSS scope.

controls.title: Security awareness program implemented
controls.description: All personnel made aware of importance of security and cardholder data protection.

controls.title: List of TPSPs maintained
controls.description: Third-party service providers with which cardholder data is shared.

controls.title: Incident response plan exists and is tested
controls.description: Reviewed at least annually.
